# 14ers.com

> > Comprehensive guide to climbing Colorado's 14ers and 13ers with detailed routes, trail maps, GPX/KML downloads, and mountaineering resources.

14ers.com is the premier resource for Colorado mountain climbing, featuring climbing routes, photos, downloadable GPS data (GPX, KML, CSV), trailhead information, and weather resources (SNOTEL, NOAA) for the state's highest peaks. The site serves mountaineers and hikers with detailed route descriptions, elevation profiles, and Leave No Trace guidelines.

## Key Topics

- Colorado 14ers
- Colorado 13ers
- Climbing routes
- Mountaineering
- Trail maps and GPX/KML/CSV downloads
- Peak information and route ratings
- Trailhead information
- Elevation gain and exposure ratings
- SNOTEL weather data
- NOAA forecasts
- Leave No Trace ethics
- Unnamed peaks and centennial peaks
- Route difficulty and risk ratings
- Colorado mountain ranges
- GPS navigation and waypoints

## Peak Directories

- [Colorado 13ers](https://www.14ers.com/13ers): Colorado 13ers main directory with routes, photos, and trail guides
- [Routes List](https://www.14ers.com/routelist.php): Complete route list for Colorado 14ers and peaks with export options
- [Route Details](https://www.14ers.com/route.php): Individual route details with GPX/KML/CSV downloads for Colorado peaks

## Route Planning Resources

- [Route Glossary](https://www.14ers.com/info_route.php): Route terminology guide: elevation gain, exposure, risk ratings, GPS metrics

## 14er Peak Pages

- [Redcloud Peak](https://www.14ers.com/peaks/10046/redcloud-peak): Redcloud Peak 14er climbing routes and detailed peak information
- [Mt. of the Holy Cross](https://www.14ers.com/peaks/10051/mt-of-the-holy-cross): Mt. of the Holy Cross 14er routes with GPX/KML trail data
